notes.title: 🗣️ Hello Kate Walker ⚙️ Syberia - Remastered Coming in 2025
notes.content:
Some adventures should never end…

This winter, rediscover Benoît Sokal’s clockpunk universe with Syberia - Remastered!

[previewyoutube=SqHihFXG9Kc;full][/previewyoutube]
More than 20 years after its original release, Syberia is reborn in a fully modernized version. Rediscover its iconic locations and unforgettable characters through a stunning visual overhaul, redesigned gameplay, and the same captivating storytelling that made it a classic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6640461/dcbedecbb4164d22390be18daced5ced183dd716.jpg
Kate Walker, a brilliant lawyer from New York, is sent to a remote village in the French Alps to finalize the sale of an old automaton factory. But what begins as a routine assignment soon turns into an extraordinary journey across Eastern Europe and its snow-covered landscapes.

Accompanied by Oscar, a loyal and one-of-a-kind automaton, Kate sets out to explore mysterious and forgotten places, filled with eccentric characters, as she follows the trail of Hans Voralberg, a genius inventor pursuing a seemingly impossible dream: finding the last living mammoths on the mythical island of Syberia.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6640461/50fb9ad754c3fce325a283e86562d1c7f2de17e2.jpg
An unexpected, thrilling, and deeply emotional voyage that will challenge everything she thought she knew. First released in 2002, Syberia became a reference in the adventure genre, praised for its unique atmosphere, sharp writing, and the richness of Benoît Sokal’s artistic vision. This remaster is a new opportunity to (re)discover the masterpiece, following in the footsteps of other titles from Benoît Sokal such as “Syberia: The World Before” and the newly released “Amerzone: The Explorer’s Legacy”.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6640461/ed6a70a4ae1fb2c9d350eab818a8f30af0c606fb.jpg

notes.title: 🔎 A closer look at Microids Studio Paris, creator of the Amerzone remake
notes.content:
Benoît Sokal’s iconic adventure game, Amerzone - The Explorer's Legacy, is about to return with an ambitious remake that’s more immersive than ever. Here, you can learn more about the designers behind the game...

“We work well together as a team”

This remake of Amerzone – a faithful update that promises some new features – is in the hands of Microids Studio Paris. Formed in October 2021, the team has been built around former developers from the studio Koalabs, maker of Syberia 3 and Syberia: The World Before. Today, it includes more than 60 members, working at the headquarters of Microids in the 19th arrondissement of Paris. “Being on the same premises as our publisher is a plus point,” Antoine Babary, Audio Director, told us. “It helps us communicate more smoothly and make decisions faster.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915176/3e76daf9683225a56c7d75b30de501c1c836d31b.jpg

According to the team members, the human size of Microids Studio Paris creates a close and supportive environment. “When we have an idea to improve the game, we can talk about it and reach a decision pretty fast, without having to deal with layers of hierarchy,” Édouard Bourgeat, Principal Sound Designer, stated. “We work well together as a team; most of the members have already delivered at least one game together,” added Grégory Chicoine, Level Designer. “Delivery is a high-pressure stage in development, which proves the ability to work together.”

Experts in Sokal-esque adventure games

Through its work on the Syberia series over the years, Microids Studio Paris has developed expertise in the adventure game genre. “Working on Syberia allowed me to level up my skills, particularly with camera angles: what do we want to show, and how to show it?”, Grégory explained. “This experience with Syberia helped me a lot with Amerzone; we started out on a solid basis.”

The studio's background with Syberia means that it masters the world of Benoît Sokal better than anyone. “From the music to the visuals and the mechanics, there are many similarities between Syberia and Amerzone. By understanding one, we can enhance the other,” Antoine pointed out. “What’s more, our creative leads have a long history of collaboration with Benoît; they know his work inside out,” added Édouard. “This means we can produce a remake of Amerzone that’s as close as possible to what Benoît would have wanted.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915176/ed8f473fa7c46e682d755dec72e67ec219b75d67.jpg

Furthermore, Microids Studio Paris has been honing its skills with its tool of choice, the Unity engine, achieving ever greater performance. “Syberia and Amerzone share a lot of technologies,” Grégory explained. “The foundations were already there, allowing us to focus on improvements and new features, like the point-of-view and sequence shots.”

Creating a remake that lives up to the cult game

Thanks to its expertise in adventure games, its solid development processes and its deep knowledge of Benoît Sokal’s work, the studio firmly believes that it can deliver the remake of Amerzone that players deserve. “With our background, we’re confident that we’re well positioned to meet the expectations,” stated Édouard. “The team has risen to all the challenges, and has strived to push the experience as far as possible,” added Antoine. “I really believe we can be proud of what we’ve accomplished,” Grégory concluded.

notes.title: 🎉 Celebrate Syberia’s 20th anniversary with an exclusive video 🎉
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

The Syberia series is now 20 years old!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952955/9d04ddc7be7855ce5c585c6401ff6f6d606fb0c3.png

On this occasion, we want to celebrate both this anniversary and the launch of Syberia: The World Before with an exclusive video commemorating the cult saga created by Benoît Sokal.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BGXhpJeQ1Q8

“In the mid 90’s, the encounter between Benoît Sokal and Microids gave birth to Amerzone: The Explorer's Legacy. Celebrated by players and critics alike for its audacity, scenario and advanced game mechanics, this game allowed Benoît to keep developing his fictional universes in a new medium. For 20 years, it’s been a great honor to be able to offer players around the world a unique journey in the world created by Benoît, throughout the numerous iterations of the Syberia series. Today, all our thoughts are for this incredibly talented artist who passed in 2021, as well as his wife Martine and his kids Hugo and Jules, without whom none of these projects would have been possible. We feel it was important for us to offer Syberia’s fans this video highlighting the important moments of this cult video game saga.” declares Elliot Grassiano, founder and COO of Microids.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952955/9b2c0559d08b7ef31b16911d63a66f1ae332ee18.jpg

Whether you’re a long-time fan or just discovered the series this year, thank you, dear Adventurers, for supporting Syberia ❤

What is your best memory of the series?

Want to know even more about Syberia and other Microids games?

Discover Microids Backstage!

Paying tribute to the Syberia saga, the first blog post focuses on this cult video game IP.

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards are now available!!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

We have added Steam Trading cards to Syberia - The World Before! here's how they work:

Steam Trading Cards are collectible cards players get by playing games on Steam. By collecting the entire set of cards, they earn items that help them customize their profile!


     Collect cards - Users can play a participating game to get trading cards. Half the card set is received during gameplay (based on playtime in the game), the other half is earned through collecting (trading with or buying from other users through Steam and the Steam Community Market).
     Craft badges - A full set of cards can be crafted into a game badge that can be prominently displayed on the profile and the mini profile (seen when hovering on a user's avatar.)
     Get rewards - During badge crafting users receive random rewards from a set of game related items including emoticons, profile backgrounds, and coupons.


What you can now unlock: 


 Trading Cards: 11 collectible cards
 Badges: 5 levels + 1 Foil
 8 Backgrounds for your Steam Profile
 9 emoticons

notes.title: Syberia The World Before : Soundtrack
notes.content:
We are delighted with your positive feedback on the Prologue and before sharing any more details on the game we would like to thank you with music!

The amazing soundtrack of Syberia: the World Before could only be achieved thanks to the help of the world-famous composer Inon Zur, with whom we are honored to partner with once again. He has created incredible and memorable video game soundtracks and it is with great pleasure that we give you a first glimpse of what he has put his mind and ears to for the new Syberia title. 

Please enjoy the first 3 official game soundtracks:
- Kate’s Theme : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4AgwxEQpuR8
- Elegia : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aO6JjMVViQI&t=41s
- Dana’s Theme : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5CxfiNMEMa0

We hope you will enjoy the tremendous work done here to bring again life to the unique world of Syberia.

Music is a major part of the franchise and Syberia: The World Before will raise that bar higher than before…
We can’t wait to share more with you so stay tuned for future news and announcements!

The Microids Team
